facts_and_legal_conflicts.fact: Sophon Tag/Flash install.sh pins duplexjev-vllm==0.3.0; upstream DuplexJev v1.5 (2026-11-03) says duplexjev-vllm>=0.4 is needed for audio_full_length, warning older code can drop about 4% at the end of 30s chunks. DuplexJev-32B-Para config has audio_full_length=true; Sophon nested thinker/config.json has different architecture schema without that top-level flag.
facts_and_legal_conflicts.not_proven: No Sophon runtime was run; its custom Qwen3-VL speaker processor may handle audio timing separately, so direct failure cannot be inferred.
facts_and_legal_conflicts.action: Audit actual source-level audio frame-to-token rate and 30s trailing audio with pinned backend ABI; no auto-upgrade of 0.3 to 0.4 without compatibility proof.
